{{Tocright}}

= Mineral Modifiers =
'''Modifiers''' are special qualities that can appear on [[Minerals]] and affect their sell value, appearance, and [[Museum]] bonus. 

Limited-event modifiers often have different uses during the event, but do not affect sell value and do not give a Museum bonus. 

The {{Stat|Modifier Boost}} [[Stats|stat]] increases the chance of getting a modified ore from panning.
